questions.question: What is the purpose of multi-speed axles and auxiliary transmissions?

options.text: To make a vehicle run more smoothly

questions.explanation: Multi-speed rear axles and auxiliary transmissions add extra gears to a vehicle.

questions.question: On a bus, where should carry-on baggage be stored?

options.text: In a way that lets passengers exit through any window or door in an emergency
In the aisle near the front of the bus

questions.correctAnswerText: In a way that lets passengers exit through any window or door in an emergency
questions.explanation: Keep the aisles and stairwells clear. Store luggage and freight so passengers can exit through any window or door in an emergency.

questions.question: When backing a truck, what should you do?

options.text: Only use the driver's side mirrors

questions.explanation: When backing a truck, always use the mirrors on both sides. Have someone help you whenever you can.

questions.question: What might rust around wheel nuts mean?
questions.explanation: Check your tires before every drive. Rust around wheel nuts may show that they are loose.

questions.question: If you are not sure how to put out a vehicle fire, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If you do not know what kind of fire extinguisher to use, wait for the firefighters to arrive and let them put out the fire.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a type of driving distraction?
questions.explanation: Driving distractions are physical (like reaching for an object), mental (like talking with a passenger), or both (like using a hand-held phone).

questions.question: Why is texting while driving especially dangerous?

options.text: It is both a mental and physical distraction
A message might upset the driver
People like to read and focus too much on their phones

questions.correctAnswerText: It is both a mental and physical distraction
questions.explanation: Texting while driving is dangerous because it distracts your mind from the road and requires you to take at least one hand off the wheel.

questions.question: What should get extra attention during a winter pre-trip inspection?
questions.explanation: During winter pre-trip inspections, check the coolant and antifreeze levels, defrosting and heating equipment, wiper blades and windshield washer, tires and chains, lights and reflectors, windows and mirrors, steps and deck plates, radiator shutters, and exhaust system.

questions.question: How should you warn drivers behind you that you are slowing down?

options.text: Turn on the right turn signal, then the left turn signal
Tap your brake pedal a few times to flash your brake lights
Swerve side to side to get their attention

questions.correctAnswerText: Tap your brake pedal a few times to flash your brake lights
questions.explanation: Lightly tap your brake pedal a few times to flash your brake lights. This tells other drivers that you are slowing down.

questions.question: If involved in an accident, which action is not recommended?

options.text: Try to move your vehicle to the side of the road

questions.explanation: After an accident, protect the area, notify authorities, care for the injured, collect information, and report the accident. Leaving the scene can cause you to lose your license.

questions.question: What is the name for a thin layer of ice on road surfaces?
questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice. You can see the road through it. It may look like the road is just wet. Be very careful when the temperature is below freezing and the road looks wet.

questions.question: If you do not know the area where you need to back up, what should you do?

options.text: Get out of your vehicle and walk around the area to see what is there
Do not use both side mirrors because they can distract you
Wait to see how someone else backs up in that area

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of your vehicle and walk around the area to see what is there
questions.explanation: Before backing up, get out and look at where you will go. Check that you have enough space on the sides and above your vehicle.

questions.question: If there is a fire in the cargo of a box trailer, should you open the doors?

options.text: No, do not open the trailer doors
Cover the trailer with a large, heavy blanket

questions.correctAnswerText: No, do not open the trailer doors
questions.explanation: Do not open trailer doors during a cargo fire, especially if the cargo is hazardous. Opening the doors gives the fire more oxygen, which makes it burn hotter and larger.

questions.question: When you check the fifth wheel gap during a pre-trip inspection, what should you look for?

options.text: The locking jaws should be open
The locking jaws should be fully closed around the kingpin
The locking jaws should be loose

questions.correctAnswerText: The locking jaws should be fully closed around the kingpin
questions.explanation: Check that the fifth wheel locking jaws are closed tightly around the kingpin shaft, not around the kingpin head.

questions.question: How should you view drivers who are talking to passengers in their vehicle?
questions.explanation: Drivers talking to passengers may not be paying full attention to the road. Be extra careful when driving near them.

questions.question: How often should you stop to rest while driving to avoid becoming tired?
questions.explanation: Take a break at least once every two hours or every 100 miles to reduce the risk of becoming tired on a long trip.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is safe to drive on a tire with one or two missing lug nuts
A cracked lock ring on a rim is safe if you are not driving faster than 55 mph
A missing clamp on a rim is dangerous and must be fixed

questions.correctAnswerText: A missing clamp on a rim is dangerous and must be fixed
questions.explanation: Missing clamps, spacers, studs, or lugs are dangerous. Cracked or bent lock rings are also dangerous. Check that your tires and rims are in good condition before driving.

questions.question: What is the minimum tread depth for rear tires?
questions.explanation: Front tires must have at least 4/32 of an inch of tread depth. Other tires must have at least 2/32 of an inch of tread depth. All tires on the same vehicle should be the same size.

questions.question: What happens when a vehicle hydroplanes?

options.text: The tires lose contact with the road
The trailer disconnects from the truck
The vehicle becomes easier to control

questions.correctAnswerText: The tires lose contact with the road
questions.explanation: On wet roads, tires can lose grip and slide on the water. This is called hydroplaning. It can happen at speeds as low as 30 mph.

questions.question: If you are not sure if your vehicle fits under a bridge or sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If you are not certain your vehicle will fit under something overhead, slow down and take a different route if you can.
